name: The Commons
tagline: A cross-user match-maker for ML experiments, backed by a PI Lab–operated evidence library.
summary: Layer 3 of PI Lab's three-layer system. pcq is the evidence contract, cq is the press that produces evidence, The Commons ranks which experiment to run next. The match-maker is the role; the library is the mechanism. Objective is information gain — rank the next experiment that most reduces problem-region uncertainty, using negatives as an explicit signal (not an expected-metric leaderboard). Stateless advisor: cq holds cycle state. Ownership: PI Lab proprietary platform (Palantir/HuggingFace posture) — code is Apache-2.0 OSS (self-hostable); the operated instance and collected corpus are PI Lab assets; contributors get attribution + mileage, not evidence ownership.

status.recommend_objective: information-gain (v0.1 listwise rerank = placeholder for negatives-aware ranking)
known_v01_limitations: L2 immutability is policy-level, not DB-enforced (reciprocity_event/retirement_audit/lineage_edge append-only by convention; v0.2 ops cycle)
Operator audit trail absent — PI Lab mutations policy-permitted; detection limited to corpus-export round-trip release gate (separate governance-honesty cycle)
Embedding stale auto-recompute absent — embedding_template_ver tracks but a model bump leaves prior embeddings until re-ingest (v0.2)
lineage_edge (derives_from/reproduces/contradicts/compared_to) stored from v0.1 but match-maker does not read it yet (forward-compat; v0.2 activates lineage-aware ranking)

pcq Reproducibility Pack (code/seeds/data_ref) accepted/stored/integrity-hashed from v0.1 but match-maker does not consume for ranking yet (v0.2 reproduce-verify before promote: matching content_sha256 -> promote signal, mismatch -> contradicts event)
PHI-stripped matchmaker policy absent — data_ref present with content_sha256=None is hash-identical to data_ref absent (PHI dual-gate); v0.2 marks via data_ref.uri presence inspection
intent.tolerance is opinion-shaped — v0.2 reframing candidate (alongside pcq next cycle) to stochastic variance fact for reproduce-verify integration

reproducibility_claim.canonical_phrase: pcq makes evidence reproducible, not execution-attested.
reproducibility_claim.scope: pcq Reproducibility Pack (code/seeds/data_ref) records WHAT code, seeds, and data were used in content-addressed form. It does NOT prove the recorded code actually ran to produce the recorded outputs — causal attestation (TEE/SLSA/sigstore) is a separate substrate The Commons does not currently consume. Match-maker treats reproduction as signal, not proof.

resources.pcq_2x_proposal: https://playidea-lab.github.io/TC/pcq-2.x.md (NOT canonical — canonical pcq 2.x defined by pcq spec/, vendored by TC)

core_principles: The match-maker is the role; the evidence library is the mechanism.
Objective is information gain — rank the next experiment that most reduces problem-region uncertainty, not the expected-metric winner.
Raw evidence is the knowledge unit, not a prose summary.
Negative and failed results are first-class — they explicitly narrow the search space.
Synthetic evidence is a seed, not a destination — auto-retires when real accumulates.
Contribution earns attribution + mileage — PI Lab proprietary platform, code is Apache-2.0 OSS, corpus is a PI Lab asset.
Not AutoML — plans your next experiment from other users' evidence.

matchmaker.objective: information-gain (negatives explicit); v0.1 listwise rerank = placeholder for the negatives-aware reranker
stages: Gemini 2.5 Flash listwise rerank, top-N (default 5) with reasons

http_surface.role: pcq 2.x evidence -> validate, embed, store, promote/contradict

evidence_model.L1: immutable — stored run record never changes
evidence_model.L2: append-only — lineage and reciprocity events accrete
evidence_model.L3: mutable visibility — synthetic-vs-real status and retirement only
evidence_model.verifier: server-derived at read time, never stored on the record

events: loop_closure — one contributor's evidence measurably influences another's recommendation
synthetic_retirement — accumulated real evidence auto-retires synthetic for a cluster
verification_by_reproduction — a user's reproduction promotes or contradicts a record

agent_rule: The Commons reports facts and ranked candidates with reasons; the calling agent or service chooses policy. Negatives in the result set are signal, not noise.
